newsitem.title: USA: Dow industrials, Nasdaq steam higher, extend gains.
newsitem.headline: Dow industrials, Nasdaq steam higher, extend gains.

text.p: U.S. blue chip stocks and the Nasdaq composite moved steadily higher on Friday, continuing Wall Street's recent breakneck rally.

While trading was volatile because of the expiration of index futures and options, the Dow industrials added around 23 points, or 0.29 percent, to 7780. Nasdaq was up 3.43 points at around 1451, pushing up from yesterday's record-level close.

"The stock market has a lot going for it," Tom Carpenter, a managing director and chief economist at ASB Capital Management Inc. "It is feeling the benefit of several economic variables which are going its way."
There seemed to be little chance the Federal Reserve would tighten short-term interest rates in July, and both oil and gold prices were moving lower, he said.
"There is little pressure on inflation from the commodities and oil front," Carpenter said.
In this environment of both moderate growth and inflation, the stock market faced few hurdles which might block its rise, analysts said.
The Dow also drew support from a firming long bond, which rose 8/32 down to a 6.66 percent yield.
